name: CASUALTY_12_HOUR_HOSPITAL_SYMBOL_BLUE_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet S1 (12 hour casualty service symbol; one sheet for S1-H HOSPITAL, S1-C CLINIC and S1-F FIRST AID — the plate is drawn with HOSPITAL and the other two words are given below it with their widths). 350 x 350 blue, no border. White cross 177 x 177 (86 / 177 / 87 across, 40 from the top), arms 58 wide (59 / 58 / 59). HOSPITAL 50 D white, baseline 315 (98 below the cross, 35 from the bottom), ink 303.
